leadText:
Pokémon: Partner Up with... are a series of DVDs that were released by Beyond Home Entertainment for DVD Region 4.

Each single release contains a single disc with four episodes of about the Pokémon featured on the cover. The episodes are selected from the first 12 seasons. 

They are similar to the Pokémon: Partner Up with... series which was released in the United Kingdom by Manga Entertainment.
plainText:
Pokémon: Partner Up with... are a series of DVDs that were released by Beyond Home Entertainment for DVD Region 4.

Each single release contains a single disc with four episodes of about the Pokémon featured on the cover. The episodes are selected from the first 12 seasons. 

They are similar to the Pokémon: Partner Up with... series which was released in the United Kingdom by Manga Entertainment.

==Pokémon: Partner Up with Pikachu==
 
Pokémon: Partner Up with Pikachu is the first of the four releases of 2019. It was released in Australia on April 23, 2019 with the catalogue number BHE8138.
 

==Pokémon: Partner Up with Charmander==
 
Pokémon: Partner Up with Charmander is the second of the four releases of 2019. It was released in Australia on April 23, 2019 with the catalogue number BHE8164.
 

==Pokémon: Partner Up with Squirtle==
 
Pokémon: Partner Up with Squirtle is the third of the four releases of 2019. It was released in Australia on April 23, 2019 with the catalogue number BHE8165.
 

==Pokémon: Partner Up with Bulbasaur==
 
Pokémon: Partner Up with Bulbasaur is the last of the four releases of 2019. It was released in Australia on April 23, 2019 with the catalogue number BHE8163.
